knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A useful service definition states the tasks, surfaces, exclusions and standard, as the lesson describes. 'We clean houses' (option 0) and 'we do everything you need' (option 2) are vague and invite disputes.

The lesson says a service the business is not licensed for must be excluded or referred, and that defining a service does not grant a licence. Offering it and finding a licence later (option 0) and doing it without telling anyone (option 2) are not permitted.
The describe the service section says a vague offer such as 'we clean houses' invites every request and every dispute.

practicalCriteria: Learner writes a service definition for a supplied service with tasks, surfaces, standard and stated exclusions.
Learner records the skills, equipment, products and licence requirements for a supplied service and decides offer, exclude or refer.
Learner uses the same service description in a supplied quote and work order.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Approved service offer document with review date
Record of each excluded or referred service and the reason
stopWorkCriteria: Learner offers a regulated service the business does not hold the licence for
